key.name: show-cpu
key.description: Show the total processor load as a percentage in the panel.

key.name: show-memory
key.description: Show used RAM as a percentage in the panel.

key.name: show-network
key.description: Show download and upload rate of the physical interfaces in the panel.

key.name: show-disk
key.description: Show used space of the root filesystem as a percentage in the panel.

key.name: show-temperature
key.description: Show the processor temperature in degrees Celsius in the panel.

key.name: show-labels
key.description: Prefix every value with a short label such as CPU or RAM.

key.name: panel-position
key.description: Which box of the top panel holds the indicator.

key.name: panel-index
key.description: Index of the indicator inside the chosen panel box. 1 places it right after the Activities button.
